sources.name: Université de Sherbrooke - International Relations
sources.notes: Reachable (200, readable page), but 'Important Dates' only lists application deadlines and term start/end (Fall 2026: last week of August - third week of December), not bookable events - a content gap, not an access gap, so registered manual rather than probe. No feed found; the general UdeS activities/conferences calendar mentioned in search results wasn't confirmed reachable this pass - worth a follow-up probe for a TYPO3/Drupal JSON route similar to Montreal's UdeM site.

sources.name: Bishop's University - Bishop's International
sources.notes: WordPress site (wp-json present) but no Events Calendar/tribe route registered (404 on wp-json/tribe) - events are hand-authored on a static page. As of 2026-08-26 the page only shows a Winter-term-specific weekly Friday 7-9pm hangout (started Jan 17, stale for fall) and a past June graduation event - no Fall 2026 dates published yet. Content gap; re-check in September once the fall international office schedule is posted (their Facebook/Instagram are more current than the site per the page's own note).

sources.name: Bibliothèques de Sherbrooke
sources.notes: Unlike Hamilton/Kingston, Sherbrooke's 5-branch library network does not run Communico - it runs a 'biblio-mondo' ILS (Mondotexte) SPA. Its own settings.js literally reports 'noEventAgenda':true, confirming the catalog's events module is disabled. Fall library programming is announced via a separate news article/PDF ('Programmation d'automne des bibliothèques municipales') rather than a structured calendar - no feed found. Registered probe; a scrape of the city calendar page below may be the more productive angle.

sources.name: Université de Sherbrooke - Agenda institutionnel
sources.notes: The full campus-wide event calendar (28 pages of results for the 3-month window: conferences, thesis defenses, sports games, institutional/formation/student-tagged events) - reachable via WebFetch (200) though plain curl gets 403 (Akamai bot check tolerates a real browser fetch, not a bare UA). No JSONAPI/RSS found. Same shape as Queen's University's central calendar in Kingston, which needed a dedicated scrape parser (queensu_drupal) with a title-blocklist to cut internal-program noise - this would need the equivalent custom parser to become live; out of scope this session (reusable kinds only). One clearly student-relevant event ('Journée de la rentrée au Campus de la santé', Aug 27) was hand-entered under udes-international instead of building a scraper for one data point.

sources.name: Ville de Sherbrooke - Calendrier des activités
sources.notes: City-wide activities/festivals calendar (covers libraries, culture, sports); page loads (200) but no /jsonapi route or embedded widget config found on the library sub-page probed 2026-08-26. Would need a manual scrape parser to become live - out of scope this session (reusable kinds only).

sources.name: Service d'aide aux Néo-Canadiens (SANC)
sources.notes: Estrie's mandated newcomer-settlement agency since 1954 (530 Prospect St) - all services available in English via interpreter, runs monthly newcomer-orientation info sessions and 'Espace Parents' workshops. No dated public events feed found - informational/service site, not an events publisher (same content-gap pattern as Montreal's BINAM / Hamilton's HIPC). Left with an empty manual event list.

sources.name: Sherbrooke Vibrante (downtown business district)
sources.notes: Downtown Sherbrooke's business-district events aggregator (equivalent role to Downtown Kingston BIA). Site runs on a custom platform ('LANEC Solutions Web' per its generator meta tag, not Wix/Squarespace/WordPress) - ?format=json just returns the same HTML page, no JSON. No feed; registered probe.

sources.name: Marché de la Gare de Sherbrooke
sources.notes: Sherbrooke's train-station public market, a genuine walkable downtown landmark. No feed - hand-entered its Christmas Market weekends (runs Nov 14 - Dec 20, only the in-window Nov portion listed) sourced from tourism listings.

sources.name: Plymouth-Trinity United Church
sources.notes: The clearest English-language congregation found in Sherbrooke (380 Dufferin, downtown) - United Church of Canada. No ESL/international ministry explicitly advertised and no dated events feed; left with an empty manual event list per the no-recurring-events rule.

sources.name: Église Baptiste Évangélique de Sherbrooke (EBES)
sources.notes: French-language evangelical church (930 Rue du Haut-Bois S), Sunday service 10am - included as the fallback spiritual option since French is the dominant language for most Sherbrooke newcomers, unlike Montreal. No ESL/international ministry mentioned, no dated events, and the site sits behind Cloudflare (403 on ?format=json / wp-json probes) so no feed either way. Left with an empty manual event list.
